scenarios.title: 在餐厅请朋友吃饭
scenarios.setting: 周五晚上，你在一家西餐厅请朋友 Lisa 吃饭。你订了位，Lisa 对花生过敏，点餐时你要替她跟服务员确认。

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Alex
turns.en: Good evening! Do you have a reservation with us tonight?
turns.zh: 晚上好！请问您今晚有预订吗？

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你说你订了七点钟四个人的位子，报上你的名字，让服务员查一下。
turns.en: Yes — I booked a table for four at seven, under the name Zavier.

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Alex
turns.en: Found it, right this way. Can I start you off with some water — still or sparkling?
turns.zh: 查到了，这边请。先给各位上点水——要不带气的还是带气的？

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你说不带气的就行。另外你提前说明：你的朋友对花生过敏，点餐时需要跟厨房确认。
turns.en: Still for everyone, thanks. One thing to flag: my friend is allergic to peanuts, so we need to be careful with the dishes.

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Lisa
turns.en: That ribeye looks amazing. How are you having yours cooked?
turns.zh: 那个肋眼牛排看起来太棒了。你的要几分熟？

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你说你要三分熟的，沙拉的酱汁另放。又问 Lisa 要不要先点个前菜一起分。
turns.en: Medium rare for me, and the salad dressing on the side, please. Lisa, shall we share a starter first?

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Alex
turns.en: Would you like anything else — dessert, or maybe coffee?
turns.zh: 还需要点别的吗——甜点，或者咖啡？

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你说不用了。Lisa 剩下的意面打包带走，再请他把账单拿过来；这顿你们平摊。
turns.en: We're good, thanks. Could we take the rest to go, and get the bill when you're ready? Lisa — let's split the bill this time.

scenarios.title: 去诊所看医生
scenarios.setting: 你嗓子疼、发烧一整天了，在诊所前台登记后见医生。你要把症状说清楚，并听懂医生交代的吃法和注意事项。

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Emma
turns.en: Hi there. Do you have an appointment, or is this a walk-in?
turns.zh: 您好。您有预约吗，还是直接过来的？

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你说你约了十点半的。简单说症状：从昨天开始嗓子疼，还发烧。
turns.en: I made an appointment for ten thirty. I've had a sore throat since yesterday, and I have a fever too.

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Dr. Lee
turns.en: Let me take a look — say ahh. Your throat is quite red; it's most likely viral. Any other symptoms?
turns.zh: 我看一下——张嘴说啊。你的嗓子很红，多半是病毒性的。还有别的症状吗？

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你说站起来太快会头晕，昨晚基本没睡好。问他需不需要验血。
turns.en: I feel dizzy when I stand up too fast, and I barely slept last night. Do I need a blood test?

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Dr. Lee
turns.en: Not for now. I'll prescribe something for the fever and the throat. One tablet, twice a day, after meals. It may make you a little drowsy, so no driving right after a dose.
turns.zh: 暂时不用。我给你开点退烧和治嗓子的药。一天两次，饭后吃一片。这个药可能让你有点犯困，刚吃完别开车。

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Dr. Lee
turns.en: Also, drink plenty of water and get some rest. If the fever is still there after three days, come back and we will run a blood test.
turns.zh: 另外，多喝水，好好休息。如果三天之后还发烧，就回来，我们做个血检。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你问如果半夜又烧起来怎么办。另外问饮食上有没有什么要忌口的。
turns.en: If I have a fever again tonight, should I just take another tablet? And is there any food I should avoid?

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你把用法复述一遍确认，再问要不要给单位开个病假条、大概几天能好。
turns.en: Twice a day, after meals — got it. Could I get a note for work? And how many days until I should feel better?

scenarios.title: 看房
scenarios.setting: 周末你去看一套要出租的两居室，中介 Tom 带你看房。你要问清家具、杂费、押金和租期，还要确认安不安静——你经常在家办公。

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Tom
turns.en: So this is the two-bedroom I told you about. Great light in the afternoon. What do you think so far?
turns.zh: 这就是我跟你说的那套两居室。下午采光特别好。你目前感觉怎么样？

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你说整体不错，问房子是不是带家具的，床和书桌包不包。
turns.en: It looks good. Does it come furnished? Is the bed and the desk included?

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Tom
turns.en: Yes, fully furnished. The landlord covers water; electricity and internet are on you.
turns.zh: 是的，全套家具。水费房东出，电费和网费你自己付。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你接着问三笔账：杂费每月大概多少、押金多少、最短能签多久的租约。
turns.en: Roughly how much are utilities each month? And what's the deposit — and the shortest lease you'd accept?

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Tom
turns.en: Deposit is one month's rent. Most people sign for a year. The current tenant moves out on the twenty-eighth.
turns.zh: 押金是一个月房租。大家一般签一年。现在的租户二十八号搬走。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你问能不能一号搬进来，再确认晚上安不安静，因为你经常在家办公。
turns.en: Could I move in on the first? And is it quiet at night? I work from home a lot.

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Tom
turns.en: The couple upstairs has a baby, but the walls are decent — you'd barely hear them.
turns.zh: 楼上住着一对带宝宝的夫妻，不过墙的隔音还不错，基本听不见。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你说今晚考虑一下再答复。最后问一句：东西坏了是找中介还是直接找房东。
turns.en: I'll think it over tonight and let you know tomorrow. One last thing — if something breaks, do I call you or the landlord directly?

scenarios.title: 在机场和酒店
scenarios.setting: 你出差去新加坡，在机场值机时被告知航班延误，你要确认中转还赶不赶得上；落地后到酒店入住，还要谈延迟退房和订车。

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Ryan
turns.en: Good morning. Checking in for the Singapore flight? May I see your passport, please?
turns.zh: 早上好。是去新加坡的航班值机吗？请出示一下护照好吗？

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你说是的，递上护照。你想坐靠窗的位子，并说明你只有一个随身行李，不用托运。
turns.en: Yes, that's me. Could I get a window seat, please? And I only have a carry-on, nothing to check.

chunks.zh: 办理登机手续；办理入住

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Ryan
turns.en: All set. Just so you know, the flight is delayed by about an hour because of weather at the destination.
turns.zh: 办好了。提前跟您说一声，由于目的地天气原因，航班延误大约一小时。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你有点担心：你后面还有一程转机，中转只有两小时。你拿着登机牌问他还赶不赶得上。
turns.en: My boarding pass says gate twelve — with this delay, will I still make my connection? I only have a two-hour layover.

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Ryan
turns.en: You should be fine — the second flight is often held for connecting passengers. If anything changes, the app will update your gate.
turns.zh: 应该没问题——后一程航班通常会等转机的旅客。如果有变化，App 会更新你的登机口信息。

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Anna
turns.en: Welcome! Checking in with us tonight? I'll need your ID and a card for the deposit.
turns.zh: 欢迎！您今晚办理入住吗？我需要您的证件和一张用来押押金的卡。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你说是的。又问周日能不能延迟退房，因为你回程的航班是晚上的。
turns.en: Yes, checking in. One question — could I get a late checkout on Sunday? My flight home is in the evening.

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Anna
turns.en: No problem, I've noted two o'clock for you. Breakfast runs from six thirty, on the second floor.
turns.zh: 没问题，我给您备注了两点。可以，早餐从六点半开始，在二楼。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你再确认两件事：客房送餐到几点、能不能请前台帮你订周日三点去机场的出租车。
turns.en: Great, thanks. Until what time does room service run? And could the front desk book me a taxi to the airport for three on Sunday?

scenarios.title: 和朋友规划周末
scenarios.setting: 周三晚上，你和朋友 Lisa 在电话里商量周末安排：周六去徒步，周日在你家办百乐餐。还有个朋友 Tom 可能会迟到，要把计划留出余地。

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Lisa
turns.en: So — what are we doing this weekend? The weather is supposed to be amazing.
turns.zh: 说吧——这周末我们干什么？天气据说特别好。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你先问她周末有没有空，然后提议周六去城西徒步，天气正好。
turns.en: Are you free this weekend? I was thinking we go hiking in the west hills on Saturday — perfect weather for it.

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Lisa
turns.en: Hiking sounds great. Mike wants to join — he just got new boots. What about Sunday?
turns.zh: 徒步太好了。Mike 也想来——他刚买了新登山靴。周日呢？

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你提议周日晚上在你家玩桌游加百乐餐，每人带一道菜。你可以负责主食。
turns.en: Sunday evening at my place? Board games and a potluck — everyone brings one dish. I'll handle the main.

chunks.zh: 百乐餐（每人带一道菜的聚餐）

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Lisa
turns.en: Potluck works — I'll bring that salad you liked. Oh, Tom just texted: he might run late on Saturday, traffic from his side is awful.
turns.zh: 百乐餐没问题——我带你上次喜欢的那个沙拉。对了，Tom 刚发消息：他周六可能会晚点，他那边堵车很厉害。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你说那就把计划定得松一点：徒步改到十点出发，周日六点开餐。让大家别赶。
turns.en: No problem — let's make plans with some slack: hiking at ten instead of nine, potluck at six on Sunday. Nobody has to rush.

chunks.zh: 定计划、把（聚会、出行）约起来

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Lisa
turns.en: Perfect. See you Saturday — and don't forget the bug spray this time!
turns.zh: 完美。周六见——这次别忘了带驱蚊水！

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你笑说已经装包里了。周日你会带一瓶红酒，就是她上次喜欢的那款。
turns.en: Already packed, lesson learned. I'll bring a bottle on Sunday too — that red you liked last time.

scenarios.title: 去理发店
scenarios.setting: 你没预约就走进一家理发店，想赶在出差之前剪个头。你要问能不能直接剪、要等多久，并把想要的发型说清楚，最后结账时顺手把下个月的也约上。

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Sam
turns.en: Hey there. Do you have an appointment with us today?
turns.zh: 你好。你今天有预约吗？

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你说你没有预约，问他们接不接直接上门的客人，大概要等多久。
turns.en: I don't, sorry. Do you take walk-ins? How long would the wait be?

chunks.zh: 不用预约、直接上门（的顾客）

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Sam
turns.en: Sure, about twenty minutes. Take a seat — coffee's on the side there.
turns.zh: 可以的，大概等二十分钟。先坐会儿——咖啡在那边，自己倒。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 轮到你了。你说想赶在出差前剪个头：两边剪短一点，上面留点长度，别剪得太短。
turns.en: I want to get a haircut before a work trip. Shorter on the sides, keep some length on top — not too short, please.

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Sam
turns.en: Got it. Want a wash first? It makes the cut cleaner.
turns.zh: 明白。先洗个头吗？洗了剪得更干净。

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Sam
turns.en: All done. Take a look — how does that feel?
turns.zh: 剪好了。你照镜子看看——感觉怎么样？

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你说正合适，很清爽。你问多少钱、能不能刷卡付。
turns.en: That looks great, nice and clean. How much do I owe you — and can I pay by card?

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Sam
turns.en: Forty-five, and card is fine. See you in about a month, then.
turns.zh: 四十五，刷卡可以。那就一个月后见。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你说好，你现在就把下个月的预约做了，省得到时候又要等。
turns.en: Deal. Let me make an appointment for next month right now, so I don't have to wait next time.
